history.founded: An old settlement that grew significantly in importance during British colonial rule
history.city_history: Kohat developed as a key garrison town under British rule due to its strategic position controlling access through the Kohat Pass toward the tribal areas. It remains an important military and administrative center in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa today.
history.province_history: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has historically been a crossroads between South and Central Asia, home to the ancient Gandhara civilization, and later part of the Mughal Empire, Sikh Empire, and British India, before joining Pakistan in 1947. It was renamed from the North-West Frontier Province to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in 2010.
